name: Serves to a wall target box
summary: Alone at a wall, serve underhand into a taped target box above a net-height line and count serves in the box and faults.
setup: Tape a line on the wall about 0.9 m above the floor (the net) and a box about 1 m wide and 0.6 m tall above it, its bottom edge about 0.3 m over the line
Tape a floor line about 6 m from the wall (the baseline) and serve from behind it with your own legal motion, as your rules allow
Count: in the box; above the line but outside the box; a fault (below the line, a mis-hit, or a foot on or over the floor line)
Sets of 10 serves; let the rebound go, collect the balls between sets
success_criterion: In each of 3 sets of 10 serves: at most 1 fault and at least 6 in the box
safety_notes: Low intensity. Leave room behind you and to the sides so a rebound does not hit you; let rebounds go rather than chasing them. Stop if your shoulder or wrist hurts.
coach_rationale: (judgment) A repeatable serve with margin over the net keeps serve faults down (AN-05), and a serve that lands where you aim starts more rallies on your terms, which supports winning rallies on serve (AN-01). A wall gives a countable target with no court or partner. The fault rules are UNVERIFIED in this app (P7): count them as your rules allow. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
